title: Oncoskill Outreach Ledger
description: A lightweight CRM for clinics, doctors, and second-opinion outreach, so nothing is forgotten and follow-ups happen on time. Captures the lived-experience plays: which channel actually works, owner, follow-up, and escalation.

channels.description: The Institution Channel Map: the formal channel vs the one that actually works vs how to escalate.

formal_channel.description: The official route (general email, portal) — may be a black hole.

working_channel.description: The channel that actually gets a response (named person, direct email, in-person).

escalation_channel.description: Who/what to escalate to, and the de-escalation note (don't burn the bridge).

owner.description: Who owns this thread (the 'voice' for this clinic).

escalation_condition.description: When to escalate and how (e.g. 'no reply in 7 days -> polite chase; in 14 -> escalation playbook; representative/power-of-attorney if needed').

thread_link.description: Link to the email thread / record (kept by the user, not in the repo).

provenance.description: Audit trail — never silently rewrite history. Append an entry on each meaningful change.

source.description: what prompted it (a document, a reply, a claim_id)
